How Rust Achieves Memory Safety

By Jane Doe · June 1, 2025 · 8 min read

Rust guarantees memory safety at compile time without a garbage collector. This article examines the ownership system that makes it possible.

The Ownership Model

Every value in Rust has a variable called its owner. There can only be one owner at a time, and when the owner goes out of scope, the value is dropped.

  • Each value has one owner.
  • Values are moved, not copied, by default.
  • Borrowing rules are checked at compile time.

Learn more in the official Rust book chapter on ownership.
